about_the_game:
Unearther is a 2D sandbox game focused on exploration and adventure. Inspired by famous sandbox games.

Journey into the unknown earth in search of resources. Make tools and equipments to survive the dangers and lurking monsters. Craft your way of living and discover the unknown world hidden in plain sight.

Become an adventurer and explore the mysterious world, fighting off the evils or just chilling and making yourself a house or whatever.

  • Sandbox. You are free to build and break stuff in the game's world, find hidden treasures, mine ores, fight the foes and get stronger.

  • Crafting. Gather resources. Craft your tools, armors and make yourself stronger or make items and tiles, decorations at your benefits.

  • Story Mode. Dive into the lore of what is happening in the game's world. Including exclusive NPCs, items, dungeons and separate areas for you to explore and complete throughout the story.

  • Hybrid Procedural Generation. The game take advantage of both procedural generation and predefined map data to create the world. Take your time to explore areas with different environments, enemies and dangers.

  • Survival Elements. We have some elements that give you some challenges to survive. Such as hunger, temperature, breakable tools, etc. and each could be toggled to fit your preferred play style.

  • Multiplayer. Supports multiplayer up to 5 players.
